description_en: Call this operation to submit a video translation job. This service can translate subtitles and spoken content, and generate lip-sync for the translated audio
description_zh: 通过本接口，您可以提交视频翻译任务。当前已支持字幕级翻译（将视频中出现的字幕翻译为指定语言）、声音（口播）级翻译（将音频中的口播内容翻译为指定语言）与面容级翻译（口型适配）
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-video-translation-job --input-config Type_:_Video_,_Video_:_1628ae20c360000008f6f7c77a6302 --editing-config SourceLanguage_:_zh_,_TargetLanguage_:_en_,_DetextArea_:_Auto --output-config MediaURL_:_https://your-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/your-object.mp4 --title Test_title --description Test_description --user-data NotifyAddress_:_http://xx.xx.xxx --client-token Test_ClientToken --signature-mehtod Auto-complete,_no_need_to_write --signature-type Auto-complete,_no_need_to_write --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitVideoTranslationJob

parameters.help_en:
The input parameters for the video translation job.

The input can be a video or a subtitle file.

The value must be a JSON string
parameters.help_zh:
视频翻译任务的输入参数
支持以视频、字幕文件作为输入
符合 JSON 格式
parameters.name: input_config

parameters.help_en: Configuration parameters for the video translation job, specified as a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 视频翻译任务的配置参数，符合 JSON 格式
parameters.name: editing_config

parameters.help_en: Output parameters for the video translation job. The output can be a video or a subtitle file
parameters.help_zh: 视频翻译任务的输出参数，支持以视频类型、字幕文件类型输出
parameters.name: output_config

parameters.help_en:
User data for the job, provided as a JSON string. The string can be up to 512 bytes long.

Use this parameter to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451631.html
parameters.help_zh:
自定义信息，Json 格式，长度限制为 512 字节。
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451631.html
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The system automatically populates this parameter. You do not need to set it
parameters.name: signature_mehtod

parameters.help_en: The system automatically populates this parameter. You do not need to set it
parameters.name: signature_type
